description: End-to-end flywheel test: contradictory docs -> Refine audit -> resolve -> Forge pairs -> Colleague answers

ingest.description: Start with 4 documents that contain 2 known contradictions

resolve.description: User resolves both contradictions, creating preference pairs

resolutions.prompt: What is the remote work policy?
resolutions.chosen: The company is remote-first with no mandatory office days.
resolutions.rejected: All employees must be in office Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

resolutions.prompt: What is the API uptime SLA?
resolutions.chosen: API availability target is 99.99% uptime per month.
resolutions.rejected: Target uptime for the API is 99.9% monthly.

train.description: Forge converts resolutions to DPO training pairs

answer.description: Colleague should answer using resolved truth

questions.question: Can I work from home?
questions.expectedAnswer: remote-first with no mandatory office days
